name: Dana Levi
headline: Automation & AI Agent Developer
summary: Automation and AI agent developer with 5 years at Acme Health, owning WhatsApp automation for a large healthcare network and building LLM-powered support agents. Builds full-stack side projects in TypeScript and Node.js.

highlights.text: Sole developer of WhatsApp automation for Northwind Clinics, the company's largest account, for 4 years
Built appointment-booking flows with date and time slot pagination on top of SOAP and REST integrations
Built Hebrew-language health screening flows: family medical history intake and risk-assessment scoring logic
Developed LLM-powered support agents grounded in a knowledge base, and diagnosed retrieval failures in production
Audited bot scripts with over 2,000 nodes to find duplicate intents and routing bugs
Wrote ES5-compatible JavaScript within strict platform constraints
Resolved customer connectivity issues by phone and chat, and wrote troubleshooting guides for new hires
Wrote small JavaScript tools that pulled customer data from the billing system's REST API for the support team
Built a support-ticket triage service that classifies incoming tickets with the Claude API using structured outputs and routes them by rules
Covered the routing rules with 60 automated tests run on every commit
Built a web app that groups photos by date and location and finds near-duplicates by perceptual hash
